title: Savory Spice-Rubbed Strip Steak with Cinnamon Apples
description: Sirloin steak is a lean cut of beef that is perfect for grilling. The homemade spice rub cuts down on added salt and gives the steak an additional smoky flavor.
ingredients: 6 small red apples (sliced and sprinkled with 1/8 tsp cinnamon)
steps: Preheat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. In a small bowl, combine all of the spices. Sprinkle and rub the mixture over both sides of the steak.
Toss apples with ground cinnamon.
When the skillet is hot, cook the steak for 3 to 5 minutes per side, or longer if desired. Slice the steak into thin strips and serve with the cinnamon apples.

title: Strawberry Mascarpone Parfaits
description: Mascarpone is a soft Italian cream cheese. It is so creamy and smooth that only a small bit of it is needed to add depth and character to an otherwise ordinary recipe. These parfaits are healthy enough to be served with breakfast, or decadent enough for dessert, and they can be made in only a few minutes. Save this recipe for spring and summer, when strawberries are at their peak.
steps: Place 1 cup strawberries, mascarpone, sugar, flaxseed, and cinnamon in a blender, and whip until light.
Stir in yogurt. Pour 1/3 cup of mixture into each of 6 clear parfait glasses. Top with 1 layer of remaining strawberry slices (reserving 6 for garnish).

Scatter 1 Tbsp granola on top of the strawberry slices in each glass, then top each glass with another layer of remaining strawberry mixture. Add another layer of 1 Tbsp granola on top of the strawberry mixture in each glass.
Garnish each glass with 1 remaining strawberry slice. Cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to a maximum of overnight before serving.

title: Crispy Parmesan Chicken
description: This recipe provides a deliciously crispy crust with the rich flavor of Parmesan cheese. Serve the chicken with your favorite sides, such as roasted vegetables, salad, or try low-carb veggie noodles.
ingredients: 4 whole boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 4 oz each)
steps: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F.
Season both sides of the chicken breasts with kosher salt and black pepper.
Add the flour to a shallow bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs.
In a shallow dish, combine the Parmesan cheese, garlic powder, dried oregano, dried basil, and breadcrumbs.
Dredge each chicken breast in the flour, eggs, and lastly the Parmesan mixture, coating evenly. Set on a plate and repeat with the remaining chicken breasts.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breasts to the skillet and sear for 2–3 minutes on one side until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for about 15–18 minutes or until the internal temperature of the chicken reaches 165 degrees F.

title: Soymilk, Plain
description: Nutrition information for soymilk

title: Curried Roasted Beet Hummus
description: This unique version of hummus can be made with red beets as well and should be served with crudite or whole grain pita chips. If you like it spicy, add 1/4 Tsp. (or more depending on how spicy you want it) of ground cayenne pepper to the ingredients when blending.
ingredients: 1/2 lbs whole fresh golden beets (about 4 medium sized beets, destemmed and washed)
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Place unpeeled beets and garlic on a large sheet of foil. Spray generously with cooking spray and fold foil to make an air tight packet. Place in oven and bake for 45 minutes or until beets are fork tender. Set aside to cool, then peel the beets.
Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Serve room temperature or chilled.

title: Cranberry Almond Muffins
description: These Cranberry Almond Muffins can be made ahead of time and frozen once they are completely cooled. Save them for a day when you are on-the-run!
steps: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Line two muffin pans with 18 paper liners and spray lightly with cooking spray.
In a large bowl combine oats, oat flour, whole wheat flour, brown sugar substitute, baking powder, baking soda, kosher salt, and cinnamon. Mix well.
Gently fold in dried cranberries and 1/4 cup sliced almonds.
In a medium bowl whisk together buttermilk, Greek yogurt, oil, egg, vanilla and almond extracts.
Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and add the wet ingredients to the well, gently stirring until moist. Do not over mix.

Fill each muffin cup about 2/3 full with muffin batter. Sprinkle 1/2 Tsp. ground flax seed over each muffin then sprinkle the remaining 1/4 cup sliced almonds evenly over the muffins. Press the flax seed and almonds gently into the muffin batter.
Bake muffins for 20-25 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool on wire rack.

title: Baked Sockeye Salmon Fillet
description: This baked sockeye salmon is tender, flavorful, and ready in minutes. With just a few ingredients, it makes an easy, nutritious main dish for one—perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
steps: Heat your oven to 400°F. Place the salmon on a small baking sheet lined with foil or parchment.
Drizzle the olive oil over the salmon and season with salt and pepper.
Add a lemon slice on top if you like.
Bake for 10–12 minutes, or until the salmon flakes easily with a fork.
Serve warm.

title: Crab, Kale & Ricotta Lasagna Rolls with Parmesan Pumpkin Sauce
description: Pumpkin and Italian make a great combo in this delicious meal! Break out this dish when you want to impress friends and family with your culinary skills. We won’t tell them that this is actually a quick and easy meal that comes together in just 30 minutes!
ingredients: 1 bunch kale (ribs removed and leaves roughly chopped)
1/2 cup low fat grated Parmesan cheese (divided)
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions without adding salt, drain, and set aside.

To make the filling: Preheat a large saucepan over medium heat. Add 1 tsp olive oil, onion, kale, and 3 cloves of minced garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions and kale have softened, 5–6 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl. Add ricotta, crab meat, ¼ cup Parmesan, egg, and ¼ tsp pepper. Stir to combine and set aside.

To make the sauce: Return pan to medium heat. Add 1 tsp olive oil and 2 cloves of minced garlic. Cook for one minute, then add tomato paste and cook for another minute, stirring often. Add pumpkin, milk, spices, 1/8 tsp black pepper. Stir to combine and let simmer for a few minutes. Stir in ¼ cup Parmesan and remove from heat.

To assemble: Add half a cup of the sauce to the bottom of a large baking dish. Spread ¼ cup filling along the length of each lasagna noodle. Roll and place seam side down in the dish. Pour the rest of the sauce over the noodles and top each roll with mozzarella cheese. Bake for 30 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Top with fresh parsley.

title: Strawberry Banana "Ice Cream"
description: Frozen bananas are the surprising base for this creamy, soft-serve "ice cream." It's dairy-free and vegan, low in saturated fat, made with no added sugars, and still totally delicious! Perfect for when you are craving dessert. You could use fresh or frozen strawberries. If using frozen, let them thaw first.
steps: Peel bananas and slice into 1/4-inch rounds. Place in a bowl and freeze for at least 2 hours.
Once bananas are frozen, add them to a blender or food processor along with the strawberries and coconut milk. Blend on high speed 30 seconds.
Scrape down the sides of the blender and blend on high 30 more seconds. Repeat this process until mixture is smooth and the texture of soft-serve ice cream.
You can serve immediately or freeze for 30 minutes for a firmer texture.

title: Plain, Nonfat Greek Yogurt, 1 cup
description: Nutritional information for 1 cup plain, nonfat, Greek yogurt.

title: Spinach Yogurt Dip
description: Whip up this dip in no time and bring it to a picnic or party as part of a healthy side or snack.
ingredients: 1 cup frozen spinach (thawed and squeezed dry, chopped)
1 tbsp ranch-flavored salad dressing powder mix
steps: In a food processor or blender, puree the cottage cheese. Add to a medium bowl.
Add the yogurt, spinach and ranch dressing powder and whisk together. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, up to overnight.
Serve with assorted vegetables for dipping.

title: Korean Lettuce Wraps
description: Korean Lettuce Wraps are a crunchy, lower carb dinner recipe when you’re in the mood for delicious Asian food. Add an extra kick of flavor with Gochujang, Korean red pepper paste, or kimchi.
ingredients: 1 head lettuce (such as red oak, green leaf or romaine)
2 tbsp sriracha or gochujang sauce (Korean red pepper paste)
steps: In the bowl of a food processor, pulse the garlic, pear, onion, and ginger until smooth. Transfer the mixture to a medium bowl.

Add the chicken, scallion, soy sauce, sesame oil, and pepper to the bowl. Stir to coat, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. While the chicken marinates, prepare the garnishes and keep the lettuce leaves fresh.
Preheat a large cast iron skillet or sauté pan over high heat.
Add the chicken and any remaining marinade to the hot pan. Cook, stirring frequently, until most of the liquid has evaporated and the chicken is browned, about 10 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
To serve, place a lettuce leaf in your palm. Add brown rice, chicken, and any desired garnishes. Dab with gochujang, wrap, and enjoy.

title: Tuna Kebabs
description: When you’re looking to cook out, try fresh tuna flavored with an Asian-style marinade and skewered with bell peppers, tender squash, crunchy red onion, and succulent tomatoes and pineapple.
ingredients: 1 tbsp red wine vinegar (or rice vinegar)
1 lbs tuna steaks (rinsed, patted dry, and cut into 12 cubes)
1 small zucchini or yellow summer squash (cut into 12 slices)
steps: In a large glass baking dish, stir together the marinade ingredients. Remove and set aside 2 tablespoons of the marinade.
Add the fish to the marinade remaining in the dish, turning to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes-1 hour, turning occasionally.
Drain the fish, discarding the marinade. Pat the fish dry with paper towels.
Lightly spray the grill rack with cooking spray. Preheat the grill on medium high. Or lightly spray a large indoor grill pan with cooking spray. Heat over medium-high heat.

Meanwhile, soak six 12-inch wooden skewers for at least 10 minutes in cold water to keep them from charring, or use metal skewers. Lightly spray the skewers with cooking spray. For each kebab, thread each skewer with 2 tuna cubes, 2 bell pepper squares, 2 slices of squash, 2 onion wedges, 2 pineapple cubes, and 2 tomatoes. Baste with the reserved marinade.
Grill the kebabs for 4 minutes. Turn over. Grill for 3-5 minutes, or until the fish is cooked to the desired doneness.

title: Pinto Bean, Brown Rice and Spinach Salad
description: This simple salad can be on the table in under 15 minutes. It is a great way to use leftover brown rice. No queso fresco? You can use feta cheese instead.
ingredients: 1 med yellow bell pepper (seeded and diced)
5 oz baby spinach (4 lightly packed cups)
1 cup canned, low sodium pinto beans or cooked dried beans (drained and rinsed)
1/3 cup Garlicky Cilantro Lime Dressing (Link to recipe in instructions)
steps: Make the Garlicky Cilantro Lime Dressing.
In a large salad bowl combine the yellow bell pepper, cucumber, pinto beans and rice. Gently mix in the queso fresco and the dressing.
Divide spinach between 4 bowls. Top with the pinto bean and rice mix and toss.

Bulk Cooking Dry Pinto Beans: Add 1 lb (16 oz.) dry pinto beans to a large pot of boiling water (at least 6 cups of water). Boil rapidly for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and cover. Let sit for 1 hour. Drain and rinse beans. Add 6 fresh cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for one hour or until the beans are soft but not split. Makes 5 cups cooked beans. These beans can be used in any recipe calling for cooked or canned beans. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 7 days or package in freezer bags in one cup increments for up to 6 months.

Bulk Cooking Brown Rice: Add 1 lb (16 oz.) of long grain (not instant) brown rice to a large soup pot with 5 cups of water. Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed. Makes 10 cups cooked brown rice. This rice can be used in any recipe calling for cooked brown rice. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 7 days or package in freezer bags in one cup increments for up to 6 months.

title: Ranch Deviled Eggs
description: Ranch Deviled Eggs are a tasty and familiar twist on the classic recipe, making them a great addition to picnics, potlucks, or any occasion. Enjoy the creamy and herby goodness of ranch dressing in each bite!
ingredients: 1 tbsp ranch-flavored salad dressing powder mix
steps: Place the eggs in a single layer in a saucepan and cover them with water. Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for about 10 minutes.
Transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water to cool. Peel the eggs when they are cool enough to handle.
Cut the peeled hard-boiled eggs in half lengthwise and carefully remove the yolks.

Place the yolks in a bowl and mash them with a fork. To the mashed yolks, add ¼ cup low-fat mayonnaise, 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard, 1 tablespoon ranch dressing mix. Mix everything together until well combined and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Once the filling is ready, spoon or pipe it back into the egg white halves. Consider using a plastic bag with the corner snipped off for a neater look.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld. Sprinkle lightly with paprika. Serve chilled and enjoy these delicious, diabetes-friendly appetizers or snacks.

title: Superfood Smoothie
description: Blueberries, spinach, and almond milk make this a Superfood Smoothie and a great way to start your day! Superfoods provide key nutrients that are lacking in the typical western diet.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth and thick.

title: Spaghetti Squash Stir-Fry with Chicken & Veggies
description: This colorful stir-fry swaps noodles for roasted spaghetti squash, creating a lower carb base that’s still hearty and satisfying. Paired with lean chicken breast and a medley of crisp vegetables, it’s finished with a savory-sweet sesame soy sauce for balanced flavor. With plenty of fiber and protein, it’s a diabetes-friendly meal that doesn’t sacrifice taste.
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Cut the squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds. Place cut-side down on a baking sheet and roast until tender, 30–40 min. Let it cool slightly, then shred into strands with a fork.

While the squash roasts, heat 1 tsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken, season lightly with black pepper, and cook until golden and cooked through. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining teaspoon of olive oil to the skillet. Stir in the garlic, cabbage, bell pepper, and carrots. Cook for 3–5 minutes, until just tender but still crisp.
Return the chicken to the skillet along with the spaghetti squash strands and green onions. Drizzle in soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil. Toss to combine and heat through.
Divide among bowls and garnish with chopped cilantro and a lime wedge.

title: Cantaloupe Cubes
description: Nutrition information for cantaloupe

title: Spiced Sesame Peanuts
description: Sweet, spicy, and crunchy? Check, check, check! These Spiced Sesame Peanuts are bathed in the richness of maple syrup, embrace the warmth of cinnamon, and get a kick from a subtle cayenne pepper zing. It's not just a snack—it's a flavor expedition that caters to your cravings while keeping things mindful.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F and cover a sheet pan with parchment paper. In a small saucepan over medium high heat, whisk together maple syrup, salt, cinnamon, and cayenne.
Bring to a boil and remove from heat immediately.
Fold the peanuts and sesame seeds into the maple syrup mixture and spread evenly on the sheet pan.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown.
Remove the sheet pan from the oven and allow the peanuts to cool.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature.
